user.title: Connect to BitaxePID
user.description: BitaxePID must run with --serve-metrics (SERVE_METRICS=true in Docker).

data.host: Host (IP address of the machine running BitaxePID)

data_description.host: Where BitaxePID's metrics server runs, e.g. 192.168.1.20. This is the BitaxePID host, which may differ from the miner's own IP.
data_description.port: 8093 by default; in Docker, the METRICS_PORT you mapped.
data_description.scan_interval: How often to read the metrics, in seconds.
data_description.variables: Only the ticked values become sensors; unticked ones are not read.

error.cannot_connect: Could not read BitaxePID metrics from that host and port. Is it running with --serve-metrics, and is the port reachable?

abort.already_configured: This BitaxePID host and port is already added.
